mapper.select: SELECT ic.code_value FROM common_survey cs INNER JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.common_survey_id = cs.id WHERE cs.member_id = #{memberId} AND ic.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id FROM member WHERE id = #{memberId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM common_survey cs INNER JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.common_survey_id = cs.id WHERE cs.member_id = #{memberId} AND ic.status = 'ACTIVE' )

SELECT cs.first_goal_type AS goal_type1, cs.second_goal_type AS goal_type2, cs.target_amount, cs.target_period_months, cs.loan_purpose, cs.has_loan_within_one_month FROM common_survey cs WHERE cs.member_id = #{memberId} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM couple c INNER JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.id = c.invitation_code_id WHERE c.invitee_id = #{memberId} AND ic.common_survey_id = cs.id )

SELECT cs.id AS common_survey_id, c.id AS couple_id FROM common_survey cs LEFT JOIN invitation_code ic ON ic.common_survey_id = cs.id LEFT JOIN couple c ON c.invitation_code_id = ic.id WHERE cs.member_id = #{memberId} OR c.inviter_id = #{memberId} OR c.invitee_id = #{memberId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common_survey ( member_id, first_goal_type, second_goal_type, target_amount, target_period_months, loan_purpose, has_loan_within_one_month ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{firstGoalType}, #{secondGoalType}, #{targetAmount}, #{targetPeriodMonths}, #{loanPurpose}, #{hasLoanWithinOneMonth} )
INSERT IGNORE INTO invitation_code ( common_survey_id, code_value, status ) VALUES ( #{commonSurveyId}, #{codeValue}, 'ACTIVE' )
mapper.update: UPDATE common_survey SET first_goal_type = #{request.goalType1}, second_goal_type = #{request.goalType2}, target_amount = #{request.targetAmount}, target_period_months = #{request.targetPeriodMonths}, loan_purpose = #{request.loanPurpose}, has_loan_within_one_month = #{request.hasLoanWithinOneMonth}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{commonSurveyId}
